author: Oreo2000
quote: Really disappointing. Tedious silly "missions", moving furniture. Can't steal cars in my neighborhood. Can't use my "safe house" as a safe house when I'm being chased. Can't skip stupid long cutscenes. Can't map the buttons to customize controls. Every car still drives like I'm on ice. I wish I could get my money back, as I won't be playing. Can't even sell the disc, because they scammed us with digital download. I would avoid it if you're in the fence about buying, it's a serious flop
